unicode_table.note: N_B and table_r read only this

L1.scope: the reference side (Amendment 4 items 2 and 3); L1 is decided by comparing Node and Chromium with these digests
L1.record: normalised text as UTF-8 hex ('-' when empty) TAB pieces 'id,start,end,hex' separated by single spaces ('-' when none), as traces/wordpiece_v1.txt; per-instance SHA-256 over the record's UTF-8; list digest = SHA-256 of the hex lines, LF after each (the cache file)
L1.id_stream: Amendment 1 item 2: per instance LEB128(number of ids) then LEB128 of each id, instances in order

hugging_face.settings: BertWordPieceTokenizer(vocab file, lowercase=True, strip_accents=True, clean_text=True, handle_chinese_chars=True), encode(add_special_tokens=False); an instance differs when its token strings differ from ours

dry_d.source: 2000 strings, string i from Rng(4000 + i) with L1 (d)'s pool (lexicon.l1.dry)

markdown.source: the repository Markdown spike S6 used: the 10 files Pages/**/*.md at commit 7b10514, sorted by path, one instance per file (raw bytes)

1.what: S6's R(s) = drop Mn(NFD(lower(s))) from the pinned table, per case (lexicon.phase2.table_r): the reference side Node and Chromium compare the platform's toLowerCase().normalize('NFD') minus \p{Mn} against; decided there (must differ on >= 1 case)

2.what: WordPiece shortest-match-first against the registered longest-match-first; an instance differs when its record differs (must differ on >= 1 instance of dry_d or markdown)

3.what: N_B without accent stripping (lowercase kept, NFD and Mn removal skipped) against the registered pipeline; an instance differs when its record differs (must differ on >= 1 instance of dry_d or markdown)

L1.decision: decided by the Node and Chromium runners against these digests; controls 2 and 3 show their weakness in every cell

L4.scope: (a) the reference side, decided by comparing Node with it (Amendment 4 item 5); (b) decided here (item 6)

verbs-subtree.source: dry stand-in for the mammal spanning subtree: the spanning subtree of 00126264 (change, alter, modify), the verb root with the most descendants; every node a query against the others

1.what: float64 coordinates rounded to float32, the key in float32 arithmetic (numpy), every query of verbs-subtree in H3: must show >= 1 inversion, or (b) is void

2.what: the float evaluator sorting by float64 acosh(max(1, key)) then node index, against the pessimistic exact graph-edge AP, on every query of verbs-subtree in H3 with an exact neighbour/non-neighbour tie: must differ on >= 1 (N/A, not void, without ties)
